content.text: In Kenya, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-step-step-2|How Creators]] face a common problem: how to get paid internationally without relying on Stripe or other global payment processors that restrict access. The usual solution is to set up a local digital store and wait for buyers from abroad to walk in. But this approach limits sales to a single country and ignores the global market. This guide shows you how to bypass these restrictions and set up a sovereign digital commerce stack that processes international payments on Tron, Binance P2P, and other blockchain networks, making it possible to sell digital products to buyers from anywhere in the world. By using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-7|COREMERCH guide to crypto]]-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-7|cloudflare]] Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you'll be able to create a seamless checkout experience for your customers, regardless of their location. You'll also learn how to scale your infrastructure to meet growing demand, ensuring that you can process transactions quickly and efficiently.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal have restrictions on certain regions and countries. In Africa, these restrictions can make it difficult for digital creators to get paid internationally. This is where a sovereign digital commerce stack comes in. By using NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, you can process transactions on-chain, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. This approach not only reduces fees but also ensures that you retain control over your data and infrastructure. Additionally, with the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few essential tools. These include Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. You'll also need to set up a Binance account to enable fiat-to-crypto transactions. Additionally, you'll need to choose a cryptocurrency that suits your needs, such as USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Once you have these tools in place, you'll be ready to deploy your stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your store. This involves creating a webhook that fires the moment a payment confirms on-chain. You'll also need to set up Cloudflare Workers to handle the business logic of your store, including order processing and delivery. Finally, you'll need to configure Supabase to store your orders and customer data. With these components in place, you'll have a seamless checkout experience for your customers and a scalable infrastructure that can handle growing demand.
With NOWPayments, you can process transactions on-chain, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll be ready to go live. To process your first transaction, simply create a product and add it to your store. Then, configure NOWPayments to process transactions on-chain. The moment a customer makes a purchase, the payment will be verified, and the product will be delivered. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have everything you need to get started, including step-by-step instructions and a wealth of experience from our team. By following these steps, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start selling digital products internationally.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet demand. To do this, you'll need to upgrade your Cloudflare plan to handle more traffic and increase the number of workers to handle more transactions. You'll also need to configure Supabase to store more orders and customer data. Additionally, you can use Cloudflare's built-in load balancer to distribute traffic across multiple workers and prevent bottlenecks. By following these steps, you'll be able to scale your infrastructure and handle growing demand, ensuring that you can process transactions quickly and efficiently.
